title: Inheritance
text: The corpse of the Assistant’s father—the dragon… the dragon zombie has started moving.

My father, not to mention the Assistant and Keel, are staring at the scene with stunned expressions. Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and the others have gone on high alert, their feathers bristling as they let out warning cries. It’s clear at a glance that a battle is about to break out.
“…When I came last time, I told you about the dragon zombie—and now it’s actually happened.”
“Ah… ah…”
“Wyndia, calm down!”
“Gau!”
The assistant and the monster shook off Father’s attempts to stop them and dashed forward.
“Motoyasu!”
“Understood. I, Motoyasu, will burn that dragon to ashes, leaving not a single bone behind!”
“That’s not what I meant! Please, just make sure you don’t drag Wyndia and Gaelion into this!”
Huh? My father just called me out on that. Still, it seems like using powerful Magic would be the fastest way to take down that zombie dragon in one shot.
“Well then, here I go!”
“I’m telling you, we have to stop Wyndia and the others first!”
As my father starts running after the Assistant, Keel follows right behind him, and Sakura-chan speeds past them.
“Watch out!”
“Let go! My dad! He’s gone wild… I have to stop him.”
“Gau gau!”
With a thud, the monster charged ahead toward the dragon zombie and bit into it.
“Aiming Lancer V!”

For the first time in a while, I threw the spear with all my might. The spear, splitting into multiple fragments, pierced the Dragon Zombie’s vital organs and blew it away. However, the Aiming Lancer alone isn’t enough for a finishing blow. Ugh, that monster Assistant is getting in the way.
“I’m going!”

Yuki-chan starts running. Filolial-sama and the others dash forward, each attacking the Dragon Zombie as it reaches out toward the monster. That alone sent quite a few chunks of flesh flying. The Dragon Zombie doesn’t seem to be that strong after all. At this rate, this will be over in no time.
“GYAAAAAA…”
Even so, the Dragon Zombie reaches out toward the monster as if it doesn’t mind taking damage at all.
“Stop it! Father!”
The assistant is stopped by Sakura-chan and pulled into the arms of Father, who’s just caught up to her, yet she still shouts out:
“GURU…!?”
At that moment, the Dragon Zombie turned its face toward the Assistant and stopped. Hmm? Something seems off.
“Motoyasu-kun, everyone! Stop attacking!”
“Understood!”
Following Father’s orders, we temporarily halted our attack.

“Let’s stop this now… Dad. You may hate everything—everything that took everything from you. But you can’t let that cause trouble for the world or anyone else… Please, stop doing things that can’t be undone! That child is your daughter—and my little sister!”
“Gau!”
The assistant desperately tries to reason with the Dragon Zombie. Could it be that dragons retain consciousness even after death? They truly are incredibly resilient creatures.

Lord Filolial-sama the Zombie… Can I truly cherish Lord Filolial-sama, now that he has become a zombie? His eyes, completely rotted and devoid of light… his fallen feathers… his broken bones and limbs… Can I still hold affection for Lord Filolial-sama, who still tries to fight despite all that?
…Even so, I will love him just the same. Absolutely.

“Dad. Right now, I’m being protected by the Shield Hero, and I’m learning all sorts of things. The outside world is full of discoveries, just like you said. I used to worry that I’d have to set out on my own someday… but right now… I’m happy. So, Dad, please rest in peace!”
“GU! GURUuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”
The Dragon Zombie swiftly grabbed a monster that was right next to it.
“Gau!?”
“Gaelion!”
“Motoyasu! Everyone!”
At Father’s command, we all sprang into action at once. The Dragon Zombie made the flesh on its chest bulge and fired what appeared to be a large, red-glowing core… straight at the monster.
“Gau!”

The monster crawled out from the Dragon Zombie’s grasped arm… and charged straight at that core. With a “splash,” just as the red core seemed to be absorbed into the monster’s body, it emitted a flash of light.
“W-what on earth just happened!?”
After witnessing that, the Dragon Zombie turned its eyeless head toward my Assistant and my Father… and uttered a single word.
“With this… finally… Wyndia… thank you,”

it murmured, then crumbled into a gooey mess. All that remained were rotten liquid and bones. From within the flash of light, the monster floated with its eyes closed, wearing a look of pure bliss. Eventually, the light was sucked into the monster and faded away.
“Gau!”
When the monster landed and turned around, it had wings—larger than before—growing from its back, and it flapped its way back toward the Assistant.
“Did it… understand?”
“Dad…”
The Assistant seemed to be covering her face with both hands, wiping away tears.
“I… I’ll definitely live on, even for your sake. Please watch over me.”
“I didn’t think it was impossible to defeat it, but maybe this outcome was for the best? More importantly, Gaelion-chan…”
“Gau?”
“Are you okay?”
“Gau!”
Seizing the opportunity, the monster playfully nuzzled my Father and licked his face.
“Whoa! First things first, we need to check on Gaelion-chan’s condition. Wyndia-chan.”
“Okay!”
My Father and the Assistant are examining the monster. It looks like they’re checking its stats while they’re at it.
“Hmm… It seems to have gotten stronger overall? Could it be that what I thought was an attack just now was actually Gaelion-chan trying to leave me a parting gift… or something?”
“Its wings… they’ve gotten bigger.”
“Gau!”
Flapping its wings, the monster flew under my Father and the Assistant’s legs and soared upward.
“Whoa! It can fly this well now?”
“Amazing, amazing! You’ll be just like Dad before long!”
The assistant is raving about the monster in a fit of excitement.
“Mmm!”
Sakura-chan, on the other hand, looks quite displeased.
“Father, that’s enough.”
“Gau!”
The assistant’s monster is pointedly taunting Sakura-chan. That attitude deserves a thousand deaths!
“Gaelion, calm down. We know you can fly, so please don’t provoke Sakura… Anyway, we need to deal with Wyndia’s father’s bones and bodily fluids.”
“Okay! Gaelion!”
“Gau… Gyaa”
With that, the monster let go of her Father and the others and headed over to the dragon zombie’s bones.
“Wyndia, what should we do? These bones…”
“The bodily fluids have already seeped into the ground… but the bones…”
“Gyaa!”

The monster assistant tapped the bones and Father’s shield alternately. Hmm? That sound rings a bell. I feel like Gaelion from the first world used to make a similar sound. It must have something to do with that Core Stone from earlier.
“You’re right. Well then, if that’s what’s best, let’s go ahead with it.”
Having finished her conversation with the monster, the assistant turned to my father and made her request.
“Let the Shield Hero use my father’s bones. If it’ll benefit the world…”
“Are you sure it’s okay? Weren’t we supposed to lay my father to rest here?”
“Gaelion says that my father would be happier watching over us as part of the Shield Hero’s armor than sleeping here all alone.”
My father looked into the Assistant’s eyes for a moment, then nodded quietly.
“I understand. Then I’ll take your father’s bones.”
“Please… take good care of my father.”
“Okay. Alright, everyone, I’ll put some of these bones in the shield, but load the rest onto the carriage.”
“Got it!”
“Oink…”
“Elena… don’t come out of the carriage now of all times.”
The Lazy Pig spoke while tapping on something that looked like an abacus. Money again? We’re no longer short on money, you know.
“I’m not selling it. I can’t sell it.”
“Oink…”
“Seriously… Elena, you’re always just lazing around, yet you’re so sensitive when it comes to money.”
Father said that ruined the ending.
“That’s great, Wyndia-chan. You got to talk to Father one last time.”
“Yeah. Shield Hero… Once again, I look forward to working with you from now on.”
The Assistant bowed deeply to Father. The monster joined in, too.
“Likewise. With this, Wyndia-chan is finally officially one of us.”
“Yes…”

The assistant replied, looking a bit embarrassed. Then we collected the dragon zombie’s bones and finished disposing of the corpses that were causing the plague. Finally, at the request of my Father and the assistant, I used Magic to burn away the patches of land where the rotten flesh had melted. Everyone watched the flames rise. And just like that, we succeeded in eradicating the plague.
Tate and Party’s Good Deeds Points: 30 (10)
